T: Meet me at the top of the Empire State.
D: A widower's son calls a radio show and a woman across the country falls for his dad.
P: Serve dessert when they finally meet on the observation deck.
S: Flake hot-smoked salmon into cream cheese and crème fraîche with lemon, dill, capers and horseradish. Bagel chips.
Crab meat bound with a little mayo, egg, Dijon, Old Bay-style seasoning and crumbs, chilled, seared in butter until golden. Remoulade.

M: the Seattle waterfront near Sam's houseboat
Cod or flathead dipped in a batter of flour, cornflour and ice-cold lager, fried at 180C. Chips double-fried. Tartare and lemon.
Roast salmon fillet with herb crust, steamed greens and lemon butter, nothing that'll set Walter off sneezing.
W: the Empire State date on Valentine's Day
Brown butter sugar cookie dough rolled 5mm, cut into hearts, baked at 180C for 9 minutes, iced in red and white royal icing.
K: Pour-over coffee: 15g medium roast to 250g water at 94C.

s.how: Flake 200g hot-smoked salmon into 150g cream cheese and 100ml crème fraîche. Add lemon juice, chopped dill, 1 tbsp capers and 1 tsp horseradish. Slice 2 bagels thin, brush with oil and bake at 180C for 10 minutes into chips.

s.note: listening to the late night call-in show
s.how: Cook 60g butter until it smells nutty and goes golden. Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil with 3 kernels, then add 120g kernels once they pop, cover and shake until popping slows. Toss with the brown butter and flaky salt.

m.how: Mix 50g panko with chopped parsley, lemon zest and oil. Press onto 4 salmon fillets and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Steam 300g green beans. Melt 60g butter with lemon juice and spoon over everything.

w.note: the Empire State date on Valentine's Day
w.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 100g sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour. Roll to 5mm, cut into hearts and bake at 180C for 9 minutes. Ice with 300g icing sugar mixed with egg white, half tinted red.

d.how: Grind 60g medium roast beans. For each cup, pour 250ml water at 94C slowly over 15g grounds in a filter, in circles, over about three minutes. Serve with warm milk on the side for anyone who wants it.
